name: unsafe fn from_raw_handle (handle : RawHandle) -> Self
rule: Unless `handle` is `INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE` (-1), it must be an owned handle; in particular, it must be open.
api: impl  std::os::windows::io::handle::HandleOrInvalid { unsafe fn from_raw_handle (handle : std::os::windows::io::raw::RawHandle) -> Self }
expression: This requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it has no observations for whether a Windows handle is owned or open.
